bundle.shortDescription: AI meeting assistant with live transcription and coaching
bundle.longDescription: miniti transcribes every meeting live and surfaces the questions worth asking while they can still be asked. It coaches you to speak with clarity and confidence. Transcripts and insights stay on your machine. Includes a command line (miniti status, start, stop, questions, export), a control socket, a D-Bus interface and Waybar output for bars and keybinds.
